metadata.description: Exhaustive institutional capability comparison matrix: current crypto-platform vs open-source state of the art

capabilities.current_implementation: market_data/binance_fetcher.py and market_data/cache JSON storage across 28 series
capabilities.gap_analysis: Current fetcher is functional but Binance-specific; lacks automatic incremental updates for missing intervals
capabilities.rationale: Generalize fetcher with CCXT-compatible schema and automatic missing candle gap-fill while maintaining local cache integrity.

capabilities.current_implementation: research/datasets/build_data_inventory.py (100% OHLCV invariants, strict monotonicity, zero duplicates)
capabilities.best_open_source_benchmark: QuantConnect Lean Data Validator / Freqtrade validation
capabilities.gap_analysis: Platform already enforces strict mathematical invariants ($H \ge L$, $H \ge O/C$, $L \le O/C$, $V \ge 0$)
capabilities.rationale: Our current invariant audit is mathematically complete and produces machine-readable DATA_INVENTORY.json.

capabilities.current_implementation: Data fields defined in DataInventory; storage schema present but no historical perps pipeline
capabilities.gap_analysis: Historical 8-hour funding rates and hourly open interest need automated download and caching for perpetual pairs
capabilities.rationale: Add funding rate and OI historical download helpers to market_data without changing the core Market Model.

capabilities.current_implementation: Strict timestamp intersection across HTF/MTF/LTF in discovery_runner.py and DATA_INVENTORY.json
capabilities.best_open_source_benchmark: Jesse multi-timeframe candle engine & QuantConnect QuoteBarConsolidator
capabilities.gap_analysis: Current caching by closed timestamp prevents lookahead. Can be accelerated by compiling resamplers.
capabilities.rationale: Current implementation guarantees zero lookahead across all 5 canonical timeframe sets.

capabilities.current_implementation: execution/backtest/engine.py (CausalBacktestEngine, next-bar open fill, adverse intrabar collision)
capabilities.gap_analysis: Current engine matches Jesse's causal discipline while supporting high-throughput bar stepping
capabilities.rationale: Engine is causal, deterministic, and enforces next-bar execution with adverse-first intrabar stop checks.

capabilities.current_implementation: execution/costs/cost_model.py (15 bps roundtrip taker fee + 4 bps slippage)
capabilities.best_open_source_benchmark: QuantConnect Lean Fee Models & NautilusTrader fee schedules
capabilities.gap_analysis: Matches or exceeds institutional conservative standards for crypto spot/futures friction
capabilities.rationale: Prevents unrealistically profitable micro-edges from passing validation.

capabilities.current_implementation: Observations extracted ad-hoc inside strategy families (f01 through f10)
capabilities.best_open_source_benchmark: QuantConnect Alpha Insights & Freqtrade Indicators Registry
capabilities.gap_analysis: Need a centralized, decoupled observation registry (Structure, Zones, Phase, Technicals, Regimes) that sits between MarketState and Strategy Hypotheses
capabilities.rationale: Mandatory architectural requirement: formalize market_model/observations/ to allow infinite strategy hypotheses without touching the frozen Market Model.

capabilities.current_implementation: Partitioned 60% DEV / 20% VAL / 20% OOS in discovery_runner.py
capabilities.best_open_source_benchmark: VectorBT rolling walk-forward & FreqAI adaptive time-series splits
capabilities.gap_analysis: Currently single-split walk-forward; can expand to rolling multi-window anchored walk-forward
capabilities.rationale: Current 3-way chronological split is valid; expand with rolling multi-fold walk-forward validation utility.

capabilities.current_implementation: None in active architecture (present in archived legacy code)
capabilities.best_open_source_benchmark: VectorBT Monte Carlo resampler & NautilusTrader stress testing
capabilities.gap_analysis: Need trade-order shuffling, trade-dropout testing, and slippage jitter simulations to test whether edge survives bad sequencing
capabilities.rationale: High-priority upgrade to filter out curve-fit single path edges.

capabilities.gap_analysis: Need automated parameter stability scoring to reject isolated parameter spikes in favor of broad performance plateaus
capabilities.rationale: Prevents selecting an optimal parameter that collapses under 5% parameter perturbation.

capabilities.current_implementation: Strict 1% max account risk sizing: risk_amount / stop_distance
capabilities.best_open_source_benchmark: Jesse position sizing & QuantConnect risk models
capabilities.gap_analysis: Fully implemented and verified; never violates 1% risk constraint

capabilities.current_implementation: Per-trade max DD recorded in metrics; portfolio level governor defined in legacy code
capabilities.gap_analysis: Need active portfolio governor to halt new entries if cumulative portfolio drawdown exceeds threshold (e.g. 5R / 5%)
capabilities.rationale: Add portfolio governor as an external risk guard outside individual strategy logic.

capabilities.current_implementation: Phase engine identifies PULLBACK / CONTINUATION; external technical indicators present
capabilities.best_open_source_benchmark: FreqAI PCA/Mahalanobis distance & FinRL turbulence index
capabilities.gap_analysis: Need modular regime observations (Bull/Bear, High/Low Volatility, BTC Risk-On/Off) registered as strategy filters
capabilities.rationale: Classify regimes as observations in the observation registry to evaluate strategy performance conditionally.

capabilities.capability: Leakage-Safe ML Feature Pipelines & Trade Ranking
capabilities.gap_analysis: ML must NOT predict price or replace the Market Model; ML can rank entry candidate quality or classify regimes
capabilities.rationale: Establish research/ml/ scaffold for future supervised learning on entry quality without contaminating core architecture.

capabilities.gap_analysis: Non-directional cash-and-carry and funding arbitrage require independent simulation assumptions
capabilities.rationale: Establish research/arbitrage/ and research/hedging/ as isolated research families separate from directional strategies.
